name: job-agent-cloud
description: Online search for the job-search agent engine, on your own Cloudflare account (Worker + D1 + daily cron). Documents stay on your computer. Generated with Claude (Anthropic) under the author's direction.
author: manpmanp <manp.node@gmail.com>

scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

APP_PASSWORD.description: The password for your online Job Agent page. Choose a long one: anyone with it can see your postings.

SYNC_TOKEN.description: A long random text your computer's Job Agent app uses to fetch your postings (Settings > Online search). Generate one at random, for example with a password manager.

JSEARCH_API_KEY.description: Optional. A JSearch API key (Google for Jobs). Leave as is to skip.

ADZUNA_APP_ID.description: Optional. Adzuna app id (19 countries, not Sweden or Denmark). Leave as is to skip.

DB.description: Your postings, decisions and search settings.
